snippet.title: (Silent) | Explorations | Groundbreaker
snippet.description:
Groundbreaker was a pretty fun, small game. I hope with the sequel/continuation they manage to improve on it even more, maybe get rid of some of the mid to late-game tedium by giving you more to do/manage.

Check out the game here if you're interested in playing it: https://delunado.itch.io/groundbreaker
